changes.before: The Anima Christi is a Christ-centered devotional prayer built from brief invocations. It asks Christ’s soul, body, blood, the water from his side, and his Passion for sanctification, salvation, inebriation, cleansing, and strength, and asks Jesus to hear, hide the speaker within his wounds, defend, call at the hour of death, and receive the speaker into everlasting praise with the saints.
changes.after: The Anima Christi is a Christ-centered devotional prayer built from brief invocations. It asks Christ’s soul to sanctify the speaker, His body to save, His blood to inebriate, the water from His side to wash, and His Passion to strengthen. It then asks Jesus to hear, to hide the speaker within His wounds, not to let the speaker be parted from Him, to defend, to call at the hour of death, and to bid the speaker come to Him and praise Him with the saints forever.

changes.before: The Ave Regina Caelorum is the final Marian antiphon for the season from the Purification of the Blessed Virgin Mary into Holy Week. In successive salutations the faithful call Mary Queen of the heavens, Lady of the Angels, the root and gate from whom the Light arose for the world, and finally ask her to intercede with Christ.
changes.after: The Ave Regina Caelorum is the final Marian antiphon for the season from the Purification of the Blessed Virgin Mary into Holy Week. In successive salutations the faithful call Mary Queen of Heaven, Lady of the Angels, the root and gate from whom the Light arose for the world, and finally ask her to intercede with Christ.

changes.before: Skład Apostolski jest starożytnym symbolem chrzcielnym Kościoła rzymskiego, tradycyjnie ujmowanym w dwunastu artykułach. W pierwszej osobie wyznaje wiarę w Boga Ojca, Jezusa Chrystusa i Ducha Świętego, a następnie w Kościół, odpuszczenie grzechów, zmartwychwstanie ciała i życie wieczne.
